requirement: The system shall show a visitor only heritage sites that are currently open to the public, hiding any site temporarily closed for conservation work.
The system shall compute a suggested visit duration for a heritage site based on its category and the number of points of interest recorded.
The visitor selects a heritage site and a preferred language; the system displays the guided content in that language and falls back to the site's primary language if unavailable.
The visitor scans a QR marker; the system retrieves the point of interest and plays its audio description and, if the visitor has accessibility mode on, displays the transcript simultaneously.
As a visitor, I want to save heritage sites to a personal wishlist so that I can plan my itinerary later.
As a tour operator, I want to record when a heritage site is closed for conservation so that the public listing updates immediately.
A site may not be added to a public walking tour while a conservation closure overlaps the tour date.
Every edit to the public description of a heritage site must be recorded with the previous text, the new text, the editor and the timestamp.
The heritage site table shall enforce that any listed site has a name, a category from the recognised set and a non-empty primary language code.
code:
-- heritage site catalogue table
CREATE TABLE heritage_site (
    site_id           BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name              VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    category          VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
    primary_language  CHAR(5)      NOT NULL,
    open_to_public    BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    latitude          NUMERIC(9,6),
    longitude         NUMERIC(9,6),
    CONSTRAINT site_name_not_blank     CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT site_category_chk       CHECK (category IN ('ARCHAEOLOGICAL','ARCHITECTURAL','INDUSTRIAL','RELIGIOUS','MILITARY','CULTURAL_LANDSCAPE')),
    CONSTRAINT site_language_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(primary_language)) > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX site_category_idx ON heritage_site (category);
hard_negatives:
-- point of interest linked to a site
CREATE TABLE point_of_interest (
    poi_id        BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id       BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    label         VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    latitude      NUMERIC(9,6),
    longitude     NUMERIC(9,6),
    CONSTRAINT poi_site_fk FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES heritage_site(site_id),
    CONSTRAINT poi_label_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(label)) > 0)
);
-- closure notices for conservation work
CREATE TABLE closure_notice (
    closure_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    site_id      BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    from_date    DATE        NOT NULL,
    to_date      DATE        NOT NULL,
    reason       VARCHAR(200),
    CONSTRAINT closure_site_fk FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES heritage_site(site_id),
    CONSTRAINT closure_dates_order CHECK (to_date >= from_date)
);

requirement: Content authors may only edit or publish descriptions for sites assigned to them by the heritage authority.
The visitor route planner shall produce a walking order for selected sites that keeps the total walking distance under the visitor's requested maximum.
